provenance.note: Audited source is byte-for-byte the source whose hash was recorded as delivered AND executed; no FUSE-truncation fork, no hidden second code path.

candidate_free.agents: ideal + 7 fair baselines; no candidate token

non_blocking_residuals: Shuffle ablation and leakage datasets use separate seeds (SEED_SHUFFLE/SEED_LEAK) and are NOT in trace.jsonl; verified by source-logic review + internal arithmetic consistency + fail-ability (T2/T3), NOT regenerated from seed (numpy rng reproduction fragility). Zero-residual closure = a full re-run from the sha-verified source.
Prereg 'frozen-before-run' rests on same-artifact hash self-consistency, not an external timestamp; the large non-knife-edge margins argue against post-hoc threshold tuning.
